description: Solvent-accessible hydrophobic surface of the LON substrate-binding domains of LONRF1/2/3 versus LONP1
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
 'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def af(acc):
    p=f'struct/AF-{acc}.pdb'
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        r=requests.get(f'https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-{acc}-F1-model_v6.pdb',timeout=300); r.raise_for_status()
        open(p,'w').write(r.text)
    return p
def load(p):
    rows=[]
    for l in open(p):
        if l.startswith('ATOM'):
            rows.append((l[12:16].strip(),l[17:20].strip(),int(l[22:26]),
                         float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54]),l[76:78].strip(),float(l[60:66])))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['name','resn','resi','x','y','z','el','plddt'])
RAD={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80}
def sphere(n=200):
    i=np.arange(0,n,dtype=float)+0.5; phi=np.arccos(1-2*i/n); th=np.pi*(1+5**0.5)*i
    return np.c_[np.cos(th)*np.sin(phi), np.sin(th)*np.sin(phi), np.cos(phi)]
SP=sphere(240)
def sasa(df, probe=1.4):
    X=df[['x','y','z']].values; R=np.array([RAD.get(e,1.7) for e in df.el])+probe
    from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
    t=cKDTree(X); out=np.zeros(len(df))
    for i in range(len(df)):
        pts=X[i]+SP*R[i]
        nb=[j for j in t.query_ball_point(X[i], R[i]+R.max()) if j!=i]
        if nb:
            d=np.linalg.norm(pts[:,None]-X[nb][None],axis=-1)
            acc=(d>=R[nb][None,:]).all(1)
        else: acc=np.ones(len(pts),bool)
        out[i]=4*np.pi*R[i]**2*acc.mean()
    return out

HYD=set('AVLIMFWCYP')
targets={'LONRF3 LON':('Q496Y0',546,755),'LONRF2 LON':('Q1L5Z9',528,737),'LONRF1 LON':('Q17RB8',558,768),
         'LONP1 LON-N':('P36776',124,368),'LONRF3 RING2':('Q496Y0',467,504)}
res=[]
for lab,(acc,a,b) in targets.items():
    df=load(af(acc))
    sub=df[df.resi.between(a,b)].reset_index(drop=True)
    s=sasa(sub); sub['sasa']=s
    per=sub.groupby(['resi','resn']).sasa.sum().reset_index()
    per['aa']=per.resn.map(AA3)
    tot=per.sasa.sum(); hyd=per[per.aa.isin(HYD)].sasa.sum()
    pl=df[df.resi.between(a,b)].groupby('resi').plddt.first().mean()
    res.append(dict(domain=lab, residues=b-a+1, mean_pLDDT=round(pl,1),
                    total_SASA=round(tot), hydrophobic_SASA=round(hyd),
                    pct_hydrophobic_SASA=round(100*hyd/tot,1),
                    frac_hydrophobic_seq=round(100*per.aa.isin(HYD).mean(),1)))
    print(lab,'done')
R=pd.DataFrame(res)
print(R.to_string(index=False)); R.to_csv('lon_domain_sasa.csv',index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7.5,4.2))
ax.bar(R.domain,R.pct_hydrophobic_SASA,color=['#1f77b4','#4c9fd6','#90c4e8','#2ca02c','#d62728'])
for i,v in enumerate(R.pct_hydrophobic_SASA): ax.text(i,v+0.5,f'{v}%',ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel('% of solvent-accessible surface that is hydrophobic')
ax.set_title('Exposed hydrophobic surface of the LON substrate-binding domain\n(Shrake-Rupley SASA on AlphaFold models, 1.4 A probe)',fontsize=10)
plt.xticks(rotation=18,ha='right'); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
